title: ASDLC Review Sub-Prompt Companion Output
description: Machine-readable companion to a sub-prompt's Markdown narrative. Each ASDLC review sub-prompt is intended to emit, alongside its `*.md` output, a `*.json` document conforming to this schema. Structured per-condition / per-gate / per-layer / per-category verdicts allow the merge agent and downstream tooling to verify cross-agent consistency without re-parsing prose.

framework.description: Framework name as it appears in its own documentation (the [[FRAMEWORK]] orchestrator variable).

framework_version.description: Version, tag, or commit hash declared at run time (the [[FRAMEWORK_VERSION]] orchestrator variable). Use 'unknown' if not versioned.

asdlc_hash.description: Full 40-character SHA-1 commit hash of the ASDLC repository used for scoring (the [[ASDLC_HASH]] orchestrator variable).

run_date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) on which this sub-prompt was run.

sub_prompt_id.description: Identifier of the sub-prompt that emitted this output (e.g., '01', '02-l1', '02-g4', '03', '04c', '05b', '06', '07', '08b', '09').

accountable_human.description: Optional name or role of the human who reviewed this output before merge.

gate_verdicts.description: Per-gate verdicts keyed by canonical gate id. Each entry carries condition-level verdicts, the aggregated gate verdict (one of the canonical seven GateState values), and evidence anchors back into [[FRAMEWORK]]'s source.

layer_scores.description: Per-layer score keyed by canonical layer id. Score is 0-100; weight_applied is the decimal weight per the orchestrator's weighting scheme.

category_scores.description: Per-category score covering the 12 weighted categories from the orchestrator's revised weighting scheme. Each entry carries the score, the decimal weight applied, and an optional source-agent attribution.

composite_score.description: Composite score = sum(category_score * decimal_weight) over all twelve categories, rounded to one decimal place.

disclaimers.description: Disclaimers attached to this output. The self-referential-grading disclaimer (the orchestrator's preamble paragraph stating that ASDLC grades against its own assertions, not against externally-anchored regulatory or engineering source-of-truth) MUST always be present.

gate_state_enum.description: The canonical seven-state GateState enum from governance/gate-registry.yaml.gate_state_enum (also asserted in governance/graph.md).

file.description: File path within [[FRAMEWORK]]'s source corpus, relative to the framework root.

quote.description: Optional verbatim quote from the cited lines.

rationale.description: One-sentence rationale for the condition verdict.

condition_verdicts.description: Per-condition verdicts keyed by canonical condition id (e.g., 'SR-1', 'RG-3', 'DoD-2', 'RT-5'). Keys MUST match governance/gate-registry.yaml condition ids.

evidence_anchors.description: Gate-level evidence anchors (typically the artefacts that aggregate condition-level evidence).

weight_applied.description: Decimal weight (e.g., 0.18 for L2 under the current weighting scheme).

source_agent.description: Optional sub-prompt id of the authoritative source agent for this category.
